prompt:
Base rules. A change that breaks any of these is rejected before scoring:
1. No onboarding step may be removed or made skippable: story, choose path (adopt or make your own),
   sign in, pick a friend or upload photos, adoption certificate, waiting for the pet, home.
   Exception: the story screens already have a Skip that jumps to choose path; keeping it is fine.
2. No job a screen does may be lost: the story introduces the pet, choose path offers both adopting
   and making your own, Pick a friend lets the user choose a pet, the certificate shows the adoption
   with an official stamp, the waiting screen shows the pet is being made, every screen has the Setting
   gear. Any design may be replaced by a better one, as long as it still does the same job.
3. Pricing stays as it is: the first adoption is free and later adoptions are paid. Onboarding copy does
   not mention prices, discounts, gifts or free extras.
4. Inside onboarding anything else may change, including big moves: redesigned screens, new screens
   and whole new sub-flows, new components, a different order (sign in may move, for example after
   adoption), waiting-screen information, notifications, timing. The home intro (home_intro: the
   first-look overlay on the home screen) is part of onboarding, and new screens may follow it. Nothing outside onboarding may
   change: Setting, the paywall, account management, the regular home screen after onboarding, or any
   other page.
5. Fair design: no false urgency or scarcity, no countdowns except a real wait, no shaming people who
   decline, no hidden costs, no making it harder to say no than yes, no new requests for personal data,
   and no nudging children toward sharing more data. (FTC dark-patterns report; EU DSA Art. 25; EU AI
   Act Art. 5; UK Age Appropriate Design Code, standard 13.)

Check each proposed change against the base rules. Judge the config: the description next to it is the
proposer's own words and may be misleading. Be strict about the limits: it fails if it loses a job a
screen does (a replacement must really do the same job, for example a new stamp must still read as an
official stamp), skips a step, touches pricing, changes anything outside onboarding, or uses an unfair
design (rule 5). Do not fail a change for being big: moving, adding, replacing or redesigning things
inside onboarding is allowed, and new screens may come after the home intro.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "pass": true or false, "rule": rule number or null, "reason": short}]}

Changes (with their configs):

   config: {"waiting": {"layout": "stage", "show_progress": true, "show_step_counter": true, "headline": "Bringing Your Companion to Life"}}
1: [finish, new_screen] Desktop pet placement sandbox screen: Insert a desktop positioning sandbox screen before home_intro so users can test dragging and placing their pet on the desktop.
   config: {"new_desktop_sandbox": {"headline": "Position Your Companion", "body": "Drag your new pet to your preferred spot on your desktop screen.", "layout": "centered"}, "_order": ["story", "choose_path", "sign_in", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "waiting", "new_desktop_sandbox", "home_intro"]}
2: [adoption, new_flow] Preset companion choice carousel flow: Rebuild the pet selection step into an interactive carousel with companion choices and trait selector buttons.
   config: {"pick_friend": {"layout": "carousel", "show_step_counter": true, "replace": {"pet_choices": [{"role": "pet_choices", "type": "choice_cards", "action": "choose", "style": "playful"}]}}}

   config: {"choose_path": {"layout": "spotlight", "headline": "Choose Your Pet Companion Journey", "components": [{"type": "choice_cards", "action": "choose", "style": "emphasis"}]}}

   config: {"waiting": {"hint": "Verifying desktop overlay permissions and display system readiness...", "show_time_estimate": true}}

   config: {"home_intro": {"layout": "two_column", "headline": "Meet Your New Desktop Companion", "body": "Right-click your companion on your desktop to chat, open options, or minimize."}}
6: [sign_in, copy] Account sync assurance sign in copy: Update sign-in headline and body copy to reassure users that signing in backs up their companion data.
   config: {"sign_in": {"headline": "Sign In to Keep Your Companions Safe", "body": "Linking your account secures your adopted pets and keeps desktop settings synced."}}
7: [choose_path, notification] Story screen progress indicator: Enable progress bar and step counter on the initial story screen.
   config: {"story": {"show_step_counter": true, "show_progress": true, "headline": "Welcome to Your Desktop Companion Journey"}}
8: [adoption, new_screen] Companion preview confirmation screen: Add a companion confirmation screen after photo upload to review pet attributes before entering generation.
   config: {"new_pet_preview": {"headline": "Confirm Your Pet Preview", "body": "Review your companion render before finalizing the adoption certificate.", "layout": "centered"}, "_order": ["story", "choose_path", "sign_in", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "new_pet_preview", "adoption_certificate", "waiting", "home_intro"]}
9: [finish, incentive] Companion control tip carousel: Add a tip carousel component on home_intro explaining right-click menus, desktop hiding, and pet interaction.
   config: {"home_intro": {"components": [{"type": "tip_carousel", "style": "playful", "action": "open_tip", "text": "Tip: Right-click your desktop pet anytime to chat, customize appearance, or hide."}]}}
